title: Undulator Magnets for AOSC Experiment
agency: ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.FERMILAB - DOE CONTRACTOR
description_text: Fermilab is seeking to procure (2) undulator magnets for the AOSC Experiment. Please see attached for Fermilab RFP# 380252swk and associated documentation. Please ensure that you review the RFP document fully, as it outlines how to submit a complete proposal package. Important information related to this RFP: Proposal due date: 5pm Central, April 23, 2026 Proposals exceeding $10k USD must be submitted with a completed SARC and PUR-466 document Please reach out with any questions or comments pertaining to this RFP.
